BACKDROPS_TITLE.why: 'latar' is the short form of the one backdrop word

BACKDROPS_TEXTURE.why: The word photo editors and designers use

BACKDROPS_DOWNLOADING.why: Same verb as the Bible download

BACKDROPS_LICENCE.why: Same word as the CCLI licence

BACKDROPS_PICK_HINT.text: Klik salah satu gambar untuk lihat pembuat dan lisensi
BACKDROPS_PICK_HINT.back: Click one of the pictures to see the maker and licence

BACKDROPS_DIM.text: Gambar terang atau ramai, gelapkan di Tema
BACKDROPS_DIM.back: The picture is bright or busy, darken it in Theme
BACKDROPS_DIM.why: Names the Design dialog by its one word

WHY_SLOW.back: the time of waiting for an answer ran out

WHY_NOT_BIBLE.back: that file is not a Bible

WHY_DAMAGED.back: the file is broken or incomplete

why_status.why: 'error' is how the number is said

LYRICS_OFFLINE.text: Situs lirik tidak bisa dihubungi, cek koneksi internet
LYRICS_OFFLINE.back: The lyrics website cannot be reached, check the internet connection

LYRICS_NOT_FOUND.text: Situs lirik tidak punya lirik lagu itu
LYRICS_NOT_FOUND.back: The lyrics website does not have the words of that song

LYRICS_BUSY.text: Situs lirik sedang ramai. Coba lagi sekitar semenit
LYRICS_BUSY.back: The lyrics website is busy. Try again in about a minute

LYRICS_UNREADABLE.text: Artosia tidak mengerti balasan dari situs lirik
LYRICS_UNREADABLE.back: Artosia does not understand the reply from the lyrics website

lyrics_busy_for.text: Situs lirik sedang ramai. Coba lagi setelah {seconds} detik
lyrics_busy_for.back: The lyrics website is busy. Try again after {seconds} seconds

CMD_BACKDROPS_DETAIL.text: Foto dan video latar gratis untuk di belakang teks
CMD_BACKDROPS_DETAIL.back: Free backdrop photos and videos to go behind the text

LOOK_BLACK.why: Same word as the Hitam tile

TOUR_BACK.why: Not Mundur, which moves a slide

TOUR_NEXT.why: Not Maju, which moves a slide

KEYS_TO.why: Between two keys of a range

CMD_PLANS_DETAIL.text: Pindah ke rundown ibadah yang lain
CMD_PLANS_DETAIL.back: Move to the rundown of another service

CMD_PLAN_DUPLICATE_DETAIL.text: Salinannya berisi lagu dan bacaan yang sama
CMD_PLAN_DUPLICATE_DETAIL.back: The copy holds the same songs and readings

CMD_PLAN_RENAME_DETAIL.text: Ubah nama dan tanggal rundown ini
CMD_PLAN_RENAME_DETAIL.back: Change the name and date of this rundown

CMD_PLAN_DELETE_DETAIL.text: Rundown dihapus, lagu aman, bisa dikembalikan
CMD_PLAN_DELETE_DETAIL.back: The rundown is deleted, the songs are safe, it can be brought back

CMD_START_HERE_DETAIL.text: Lagu mulai dari slide yang disorot, untuk medley
CMD_START_HERE_DETAIL.back: The song starts from the highlighted slide, for a medley

CMD_NEW_ANNOUNCEMENT_DETAIL.text: Pengumuman, ayat Alkitab, atau daftar ulang tahun
CMD_NEW_ANNOUNCEMENT_DETAIL.back: A notice, Bible verses, or a list of birthdays

KEYS_MORE.text: Yang tidak tercantum: ketik di pencarian, contoh salin rundown atau tema
KEYS_MORE.back: What is not listed: type it in the search, for example copy rundown or theme
KEYS_MORE.why: Uses the product's words rundown and tema

SETTINGS_GENERAL.why: The usual word for a basic group

search_bible.back: {passage} or a word in its verse

WHY_BUSY.text: situs ramai, coba lagi sekitar semenit
WHY_BUSY.back: the website is busy, try again in about a minute
WHY_BUSY.why: Lower-case clause after a colon, no full stop; 'ramai' is how a busy site is said

START_HERE_HOW.text: Buka lagu di Preview, sorot slide tempat lagu mulai, lalu pilih perintah ini lagi
START_HERE_HOW.back: Open the song in Preview, highlight the slide where the song starts, then choose this command again
START_HERE_HOW.why: One instruction sentence in order of doing; 'sorot' matches 'slide yang disorot'

BTN_START_HERE.why: Two short words about where a song begins

CMD_EARLIER.back: Go back to what was on earlier
CMD_EARLIER.why: A verb phrase unlike 'Mundur satu slide'

CMD_EARLIER_DETAIL.text: Masuk ke Preview, slide yang disorot di tempat berhenti
CMD_EARLIER_DETAIL.back: Goes into Preview, the highlighted slide where it stopped
CMD_EARLIER_DETAIL.why: Says it is safe: only Preview is filled

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[11].1.text: Yang tadi ke Preview, tekan lagi: sebelumnya
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[11].1.back: What was on before to Preview, press again: the one before

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[5].1.text: Masukkan item di Preview ke rundown
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[5].1.back: Put the item in Preview into the rundown
